title: MSA status check-in with David
body: David says the MSA is still with procurement, behind two larger vendor renewals. No objections on substance. He expects about a month at the earliest. Confirmed the POC team stays on the implementation. Agreed to hold the order form until Michael comes back rather than chase procurement directly.

title: Capital review board timing
body: Left Priya a voicemail asking whether the expansion made this month's capital review agenda, and offered a one-page summary for the board. No reply since her April 14 email.

title: Chase signature on the regional licence
body: No answer on Liam's mobile or the Dublin office line. Didn't leave a message; he asked for time until after their period-end push, so I'll give him that before trying again.

title: Committee preview with Watanabe-san and our SE
body: Watanabe-san reviewed our proposal and pricing with our SE. Committee meets on July 14. He wants references from regional banks and the vendor risk answers before then. Sato-san will send the risk questions.

title: Recordkeeping review with Kate and our SA
body: Kate walked our solutions architect through their FAA and DOT recordkeeping requirements. Main asks: immutable audit history on cargo manifests and seven-year retention. Our SA believes the enterprise tier covers both. She wants the mapping in writing before involving procurement.

title: Configuration session with Amanda
body: Amanda and our SA settled the twelfth POC criterion with a configuration change. She'll update the write-up for the review board. Very positive; she wants to be on the rollout team.

title: Discovery call with Neil
body: Good discovery. 45 engineers, 12 shared rigs, three teams. Pain is double-booked rigs and no usage data for capex requests. Budget sits with Neil under 50k. Sent pricing tiers; he'll involve Tasha in procurement. Next: tailored demo using their rig list.

title: Stella on pilot sign-off
body: Stella is happy with the rollout plan Dale and I drafted. She'll sign off once Mona approves pricing for the eight locations. Pilot start targeted for July 15.

title: Seat flex with Derek
body: Derek asked for seat growth up to 15% mid-term at the same rate; our deal desk already approved the seat flex. He hasn't decided on the counter-offer yet and wants the terms in writing with Lena in procurement next week, for review.

title: Rollout sequencing with Marcus
body: Marcus confirmed legal is down to signature. Wants North America and EMEA live by 2026-09-30, APAC and LATAM by 2026-12-31, corporate functions last. Asked for the order form split by region so each BU sees its own seat count. Signature target July 15, after the steering committee on July 14.

title: Ian's questions on the CAD integration
body: Ian called in with questions on the CAD integration: which SolidWorks versions we cover and how file references sync. Confirmed both. He likes the phased seats and offered to champion the proposal with Rosa before the July 8 board.

title: Presentation follow-up with Leonard
body: Leonard liked the brewing schedule views. Wants a phased rollout starting with the canning line in about eight weeks. Asked about training for night shift staff; offered recorded sessions. Carla to receive the proposal.

title: Phase 2 sizing with Samir
body: Sized Phase 2 with Samir, Rachel joined the second half. Roughly 2,300 users across nine offices; London and Singapore first. Samir wants SSO groups mapped per office. Budget not approved before 2026-10-01; Rachel will sponsor the request.

title: Debrief with Victor after the deep dive
body: Victor was impressed with event replay. Main concern is cost at scale; wants pricing for 35 seats plus API volume tiers. Hannah's team to trial for two weeks. Decision expected by July 31.

title: Pilot status with Lucas
body: Lucas pleased the risk team is engaged. Fernanda's two items are the last blockers. He's targeting pilot approval by 2026-08-15. Rafael will handle paperwork once risk signs off.

title: Proposal timing with Graham
body: Left Graham a voicemail introducing myself; said a written proposal will follow Fiona's demo on 16 June. Asked who else signs off on the purchase.

title: Working session with Owen and Elena
body: Strong session. Approvals pass through five inboxes and the audit trail is rebuilt by hand each quarter. Owen wants a 30-day pilot with one deal team; Elena would own it day to day. Deal is real now, sizing at about 60 users.

title: Signature timing for the Industrial Suite
body: Left Audrey a voicemail: legal has approved the MSA. Asked whether she still plans to sign by June 30. Followed up by email with the execution copy.

title: Liability cap with Marco Bianchi
body: Left Marco a voicemail offering a short call on the liability cap before Giulia sends their position. Mentioned the 2026-09-17 board date.

title: Ethan on contract timing
body: Ethan says internal approval is with legal; signature likely by July 3. The 40 user accounts on Melina's list are ready for kickoff. No concerns on price.

title: Renewal timing check-in with Hannah
body: Hannah confirmed Rachael will approve the 50 seats once Owen's two changes are in. Renewal conversation starts 2026-09-01; Hannah wants a usage review before then. Sent the revised quote to Owen.

title: Evaluation kickoff with Tyler
body: Kicked off the evaluation with Tyler. Set up the test-scheduling workflow for two campaigns. He confirmed ITAR hosting is the gating requirement; our SA will send the hosting details. Week two starts Monday.

title: Introductory call with Mori-san
body: Mori-san from procurement introduced herself. Caleb's report should follow his reference call. She'll need our standard contract in English and a Japanese summary. Target signature 2026-09-15.

title: Javier on the July 2 budget review
body: Javier liked the trial results and will include the 24k in the budget review on July 2. Asked whether a two-year term lowers the annual price; told him I'd check with the deal desk. Sofia remains our champion.

title: Budget conversation with Oliver
body: Oliver confirmed the R&D operations budget is approved for this financial year. Wants procurement done by July 31. Helen's approval expected next week. He'd like a phased rollout starting with the Cambridge lab.

title: QBR agenda for July 15
body: Left Olivia a voicemail proposing the agenda for the July 15 QBR: research add-on adoption and Curtis's genomics lab expansion. Asked her to confirm the date.

title: EMEA seat plan review
body: Walked Hannah through the phased plan: 145 seats, Amsterdam in about six months, Munich and Lyon three months after, one order form for all three sites. She's happy with the phasing and will present it to Sarah before the planning cycle that starts 2026-09-01.

title: Trial workspace setup with Maya
body: No answer from Maya. Wanted to set up the trial workspace for her engineers ahead of the smaller ten-seat start Jared asked for. Will try again tomorrow morning.

title: Post-presentation debrief with Wendy
body: Wendy said yesterday's presentation landed well with the leads, especially the release-planning numbers. She wants a two-team trial next month before committing. Budget is hers. Asked for a trial proposal by July 3.

title: Post-presentation call with Kyle
body: Kyle liked yesterday's presentation, especially the maintenance turnaround dashboards. Wants a rollout proposal for flight operations and maintenance by July 15. Nadia's batch load test went well. Budget available this year.
